thread:
maria_evans: Heads-up — Sapphire legal needs our completed RFI + capability matrix and a POC cost breakdown by EOD Friday. They've flagged encryption and HSM questions as blockers. :eyes:

ajay-singh: Copy. Which capability matrix do they want? Feature-level (routing, caching, quant profiles) or security matrix (KMS, HSM, audit)?

maria_evans: Both. They want a single bundle: one CSV with feature flags + a short written answer to the security questionnaire. I'll drop the questionnaire PDF in the thread.

kevin.cho: For the POC estimate: if they run 2M tokens/day for 7 days, hosted costs ~ $Xk. Dedicated (reserved) with 1 node for the week is cheaper but needs 48hr lead time for infra and peering. Which direction sales prefers?

sam-sales: They asked for a hosted first-pass to move fast. But they also want a note on Dedicated pricing delta and an ops-runbook for cutover. Can we include both scenarios?

ajay-singh: Yes. I'll produce a two-row cost breakdown: Hosted vs Dedicated plus bullet list of tradeoffs. Also will include an example config for allowlisted IPs and VPC peering.

ops-jordan: Re: peering — we need their subnet ranges and a short security contact. For on-prem HSM requests, we'll need an architecture decision (KMS proxy vs HSM integration) and an engineering lead for the POC — I can own network setup if we confirm dates.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire uploaded: https://drive.redwood/sapphire/security-questionnaire-v2.pdf (answers requested inline).

maria_evans: Thanks. Ajay, can you draft the capability matrix CSV using these columns: feature, supported, notes, recommended-deployment? Add rows for: prefix-caching, continuous-batching, quantization-profiles, model-variants, routing-policies, KV-cache-ttl, KMS-integrations, HSM-support, audit-logs, SOC/ISO status.

ajay-singh: Will do. Quick sample snippet (for clarity):
```
feature,supported,notes,recommended-deployment
prefix-caching,yes,auto-prefix cache reduces token cost by 20%,hosted/dedicated
quantization-profiles,yes,FP16 + 4-bit quant recommended for cost-performance,dedicated/private
HSM-support,partial,via KMS gateway; full on-prem HSM supported in Private deployments,private
```

kevin.cho: On HSM: clarify we support customer-managed HSM via KMS/HSM integrations in Private deployments. Hosted customers can use Redwood-managed KMS but we can offer dedicated HSM on dedicated/private for enterprise contracts. Add that to the security answers.

sam-sales: Also include SLA bullets: 99.9% uptime for Dedicated (with ops add-on), 99% for hosted standard. Note canary rollback and automated fallback to smaller model variant for graceful degradation.

ajay-singh: Noted. One blocker Sapphire raised: they require audit log retention for 2 years and per-request tracing. We currently have 90-day default; can offer extended retention as paid add-on. Who can confirm retention ops + cost?

ops-jordan: I can confirm extended retention is available; ops retention add-on pricing will be a line item. I'll attach the retention pricing sheet.

maria_evans: Great. Action items: (1) Ajay — capability CSV + drafted security answers (2) Kevin — short POC cost scenarios + infra lead/time estimates (3) Jordan — retention pricing + network checklist (4) Sam — commercial ask: do we include trial credits for hosted POC?

sam-sales: Yes, let's offer $5k hosted trial credit and a discounted first-month reserved capacity option if they sign within 30 days. I'll add contract language.

ajay-singh: Uploading draft CSV + inline security responses now: https://drive.redwood/sapphire/capability-matrix-draft.csv

maria_evans: I'll review and send to Sapphire legal for a quick read before EOD. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

kevin.cho: One more note — they asked about latency SLOs with caching enabled. Typical p95 token latency with caching on our Hosted for 2k seq is ~45ms, Dedicated with optimized kernels ~25ms. Include benchmark links.

maria_evans: Perfect. Thanks team — syncing 3pm to finalize answers. :wave:
